issue.title: [HFO-05] Enforce site, subject and current-person authority on every operations surface
issue.description:
Facility selection is not an authorization boundary, and site access does not grant all sensitive record access.

**Scope**
Extend current-actor/facility controls to activity/subject reads, commands, counts, corrections, attachments, export and replay. Enforce ordinary site scope and explicit corporate/temporary coverage; preserve historical identity and live revocation.

**Acceptance**

- [ ] Site A staff cannot retrieve or infer Site B or restricted subject data through identifiers, counts, search, files, export or replay.
- [ ] A corporate actor sees only permitted sites and subject/evidence fields; coverage expires correctly.
- [ ] Revocation during a blocking lock and before retry/attachment download denies under current authority; attribution uses authenticated server identity.

**Dependencies:** [COL-18](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/issue/COL-18/reconcile-haven-repository-state-against-production-readiness-for)
**Related existing work:** See source pointers below
**Release:** Core. Implementation not started; this issue is not proof of deployment or staff acceptance.
**Source items:** Shared core contract across all applicable Admin Log items
**Source/code pointers:** `src/lib/operations/auth.ts:74, 326_sys_001_authoritative_actor_state.sql:681, 327_sys_001e_lifecycle_authorization.sql:808, R02`. Migration filenames are under `supabase/migrations/`; source paths are relative to Circle-of-Life unless explicitly named otherwise. Reconcile current main before editing.
**Open configuration questions:** Q02, Q03 See [Haven Facility Operations — Source Coverage and Open Decisions](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-source-coverage-and-open-decisions-0bf9ab4bebce).

**Build contract:** [Haven Facility Operations — Build Scope](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-build-scope-fa76df5ada21). **Sequence:** [Haven Facility Operations — Delivery Roadmap](https://linear.app/jarvislewis/document/haven-facility-operations-delivery-roadmap-eab29aa94849).

One bounded implementation segment at a time. Record exact source/commit, focused behavioral tests, applicable repository segment gates, review and rollback/handoff evidence. Preserve current authority after waits and on retries, existing dirty/concurrent work, source truth and unknown rules. No new dependency, external transmission, clinical/employment decision or policy activation is implied. Keep source/local/hosted/provider/staff/operating-cycle acceptance distinct. No named assignee, estimate or date has been invented.

Roadmap key: HFO-05 / HAVEN-ADMIN-20260909
